# statuspage_incident_template (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage incident template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_incident_template" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `body` (String) The incident body to use when applying this template.
- `component_ids` (List of String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `should_send_notifications` (Boolean)
- `should_tweet` (Boolean)
- `title` (String) The incident title to use when applying this template.
- `update_status` (String)
